title: The Will and Testament
logline: A disinherited child needs a pilot to track down and destroy the transport carrying their late mother's revised will before it reaches the sector courts.

roles.description: Bitter, highly capable, feels entirely justified in their anger.
Spoiled, oblivious to their sibling's pain.
A massive transport ship carrying legal documents.
A guild of lawyers and notaries who enforce galactic wills.

public_situation: The matriarch of a massive industrial conglomerate has died, and the {role:legal_guild} is transporting her final will from the {role:vault_station}.
private_truth: The disinherited child actually built the conglomerate with their mother, but the favored sibling manipulated her into changing the will on her deathbed.

beats.public_change: The vault station enters lockdown mode as the will is prepared for transport.

missions.reason: The engineer hires the pilot to scan the vault's outbound traffic to find the specific escort carrier holding the will.
missions.private_fact: The carrier is routing through the dark zone to avoid detection.

missions.reason: The engineer asks the pilot to meet a sympathizer at the vault and collect a backup copy of the original will.
missions.private_fact: The backup copy proves the engineer was the sole heir.

beats.public_change: The favored sibling throws a lavish preemptive celebration party.

missions.reason: The sibling hires the pilot to deliver a massive bribe to the vault's chief notary to expedite the transport.
missions.private_fact: The notary happily accepts the bribe, completely ignoring standard security protocols.

missions.reason: The sibling hires the pilot to buy and deliver heavy comm-scramblers to the vault to prevent any appeals.
missions.private_fact: The scramblers accidentally knock out the vault's main defense grid.

beats.public_change: The escort carrier enters the dark zone, accompanied by mercenary fighters.

missions.reason: The engineer pays the pilot to destroy the mercenary fighters screening the carrier.
missions.private_fact: The mercenaries are heavily armed but disorganized.

beats.public_change: The escort carrier prepares to jump to the capital.

missions.reason: The engineer begs the pilot to destroy the carrier completely, ensuring the old will remains legally binding.
missions.private_fact: The carrier captain hails the pilot, relaying the sibling's offer: half the total inheritance if the pilot stands down and lets the carrier through.

resolutions.summary: The revised will is destroyed. The older will remains active, granting the engineer control of the conglomerate. The sibling is cut off entirely.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot blew up a legal transport ship to help an engineer steal back their inheritance.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot takes the sibling's offer.
resolutions.summary: The new will arrives safely. The sibling takes control of the conglomerate and immediately squanders it. The pilot is incredibly wealthy.
The carrier easily outruns the engineer's weak attacks and delivers the will. The sibling wins, and the engineer is imprisoned for piracy.

loose_threads.detail: The notary's bribe was paid out of a corporate slush fund belonging to a rival megacorp.
The sibling accidentally lets slip that they were alone in the room when their mother died.

radio_hooks: Massive inheritance dispute heads to the galactic courts.
{role:legal_guild} assures clients that transport routes are safe.

voice_direction.disinherited_child: Angry, precise, speaks in short sentences.
voice_direction.favored_sibling: Whiny, entitled, completely oblivious to their flaws.
